reply_text:
I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co. There are no Thornbury account files I can see, and searching the knowledge brain for "Thornbury" found nothing. So I have no order-form deadline to compare it with.

I replied in your #central-team thread. In it I said:
- We should treat 23 May as unverified until someone checks it.
- If it means 23 May 2027, that's quite far off, so it's worth asking whether they meant a different date.
- The best ways to pin it down are to get it in writing from your Thornbury contact, or to ask June Osei-Lark on the deal desk whether a deadline is on file.

Your message stays in the channel record (and the brain, which saves channel messages automatically) marked as unverified, so I didn't log it a second time.
